name: Taikenmon'in no Horikawa
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 80); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: My doubt about his constancy
poems.author: Taikenmon'in no Horikawa
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 80
poems.text:
My doubt about his constancy
Is difficult to bear;
Tangled this morning are my thoughts,
As is my long black hair.
I wonder—Does he care?
